en.g: Describe your own personality and the people you know.
p: Positive words: friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Opposites help: outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Add a reason or example: I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
en.q: How would your best friend describe your personality?
en.c: Describe yourself and two people you know with three personality words each.

de.g: Du beschreibst deinen Charakter und Menschen, die du kennst.
p: Positive Wörter: friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Gegensätze helfen: outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Gib einen Grund oder ein Beispiel: I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
de.q: Wie würde dein bester Freund oder deine beste Freundin deinen Charakter beschreiben?
de.c: Beschreib dich und zwei bekannte Menschen mit je drei Charakterwörtern.

es.g: Describe tu forma de ser y la de las personas que conoces.
p: Palabras positivas: friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Los opuestos ayudan: outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Añade un motivo o ejemplo: I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
es.q: ¿Cómo describiría tu personalidad tu mejor amigo o amiga?
es.c: Descríbete a ti y a dos personas que conoces con tres adjetivos de carácter cada una.

fr.g: Décrire ton caractère et celui des personnes que tu connais.
p: Mots positifs : friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Les contraires aident : outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Ajoute une raison ou un exemple : I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
fr.q: Comment ton meilleur ami ou ta meilleure amie décrirait-il ta personnalité ?
fr.c: Décris-toi et deux personnes que tu connais avec trois mots de caractère chacun.

it.g: Descrivi il tuo carattere e quello delle persone che conosci.
p: Parole positive: friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Gli opposti aiutano: outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Aggiungi un motivo o un esempio: I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
it.q: Come descriverebbe il tuo carattere il tuo migliore amico o la tua migliore amica?
it.c: Descrivi te stesso e due persone che conosci con tre aggettivi di carattere ciascuno.

pt.g: Descreve a tua maneira de ser e a das pessoas que conheces.
p: Palavras positivas: friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Os opostos ajudam: outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Junta uma razão ou exemplo: I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
pt.q: Como é que o teu melhor amigo ou a tua melhor amiga descreveria a tua personalidade?
pt.c: Descreve-te a ti e a duas pessoas que conheces com três palavras de carácter cada.

pt_BR.g: Descreva seu jeito de ser e o das pessoas que você conhece.
p: Palavras positivas: friendly, outgoing, patient, creative, hard-working, easy-going.
Opostos ajudam: outgoing vs shy, patient vs impatient, tidy vs messy.
Dê um motivo ou exemplo: I'm quite shy, so I don't talk much at parties.
pt_BR.q: Como seu melhor amigo ou sua melhor amiga descreveria sua personalidade?
pt_BR.c: Descreva você e duas pessoas que conhece com três palavras de personalidade cada.

vocab.ex: My new neighbour is really friendly.
Tom is outgoing and loves meeting new people.
I was shy as a child, but now I'm more confident.
A good teacher is patient with students.
My sister is very creative. She paints and writes songs.
He's easy-going, so nothing really stresses him.

target.gram: Use be + (quite/really/very) + adjective for personality: She's really patient. Add so or because to give examples.

en.g: Describe what people look like clearly and precisely.
p: Hair: She has long, curly, dark hair. Order: length, then style, then colour.
Height, build and age: medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Extras: He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. Use has here, not is.
en.q: Can you describe someone in your family so I could recognise them in a crowd?
en.c: Describe three people you saw today: hair, height, age and one detail like glasses.

de.g: Du beschreibst klar und genau, wie Menschen aussehen.
p: Haare: She has long, curly, dark hair. Reihenfolge: Länge, Form, dann Farbe.
Größe, Statur, Alter: medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Details: He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. Hier immer has, nicht is.
de.q: Kannst du jemanden aus deiner Familie so beschreiben, dass ich ihn in der Menge erkenne?
de.c: Beschreib drei Menschen, die du heute gesehen hast: Haare, Größe, Alter und ein Detail.

es.g: Describe con claridad y precisión cómo son las personas.
p: Pelo: She has long, curly, dark hair. Orden: largo, forma y después color.
Altura, complexión y edad: medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Detalles: He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. Aquí se usa has, no is.
es.q: ¿Puedes describir a alguien de tu familia para que yo lo reconozca entre la gente?
es.c: Describe a tres personas que viste hoy: pelo, altura, edad y un detalle como gafas.

fr.g: Décrire clairement et précisément l'apparence des gens.
p: Cheveux : She has long, curly, dark hair. Ordre : longueur, forme, puis couleur.
Taille, silhouette, âge : medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Détails : He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. On dit has, pas is.
fr.q: Peux-tu décrire quelqu'un de ta famille pour que je le reconnaisse dans une foule ?
fr.c: Décris trois personnes vues aujourd'hui : cheveux, taille, âge et un détail comme des lunettes.

it.g: Descrivi in modo chiaro e preciso l'aspetto delle persone.
p: Capelli: She has long, curly, dark hair. Ordine: lunghezza, forma, poi colore.
Altezza, corporatura, età: medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Dettagli: He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. Si usa has, non is.
it.q: Puoi descrivere qualcuno della tua famiglia in modo che io lo riconosca tra la folla?
it.c: Descrivi tre persone viste oggi: capelli, altezza, età e un dettaglio come gli occhiali.

pt.g: Descreve com clareza e precisão o aspeto das pessoas.
p: Cabelo: She has long, curly, dark hair. Ordem: comprimento, forma e depois cor.
Altura, corpo e idade: medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Pormenores: He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. Usa-se has, não is.
pt.q: Consegues descrever alguém da tua família para eu o reconhecer no meio de muita gente?
pt.c: Descreve três pessoas que viste hoje: cabelo, altura, idade e um pormenor como óculos.

pt_BR.g: Descreva com clareza e precisão como as pessoas são.
p: Cabelo: She has long, curly, dark hair. Ordem: comprimento, forma e depois cor.
Altura, corpo e idade: medium height, slim, in his thirties, in her early twenties.
Detalhes: He wears glasses. He has a beard and freckles. Use has, não is.
pt_BR.q: Você consegue descrever alguém da sua família para eu reconhecer no meio da multidão?
pt_BR.c: Descreva três pessoas que você viu hoje: cabelo, altura, idade e um detalhe como óculos.

vocab.ex: My cousin has short, curly, brown hair.
He's medium height and quite slim.
Our new manager is in her thirties.
My dad wears glasses for reading.
The man with the grey beard is my uncle.
She has red hair and lots of freckles.

target.gram: Use have got/has for features (She has blue eyes), be for height, build and age (He's tall, in his twenties), wear for glasses.

en.g: Talk about clothes, styles and what looks good on people.
p: Styles: casual (jeans, T-shirt), smart (suit, shirt), sporty, comfortable.
Patterns and fabrics: striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Compliments: That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
en.q: What do you usually wear at the weekend, and what do you wear for special days?
en.c: Describe your favourite outfit with a style word, a pattern and a fabric.

de.g: Du sprichst über Kleidung, Stil und darüber, was gut aussieht.
p: Stile: casual (Jeans, T-Shirt), smart (Anzug, Hemd), sporty, comfortable.
Muster und Stoffe: striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Komplimente: That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
de.q: Was trägst du normalerweise am Wochenende, und was zu besonderen Anlässen?
de.c: Beschreib dein Lieblingsoutfit mit einem Stilwort, einem Muster und einem Stoff.

es.g: Habla de ropa, estilos y de lo que le queda bien a la gente.
p: Estilos: casual (vaqueros, camiseta), smart (traje, camisa), sporty, comfortable.
Estampados y tejidos: striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Cumplidos: That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
es.q: ¿Qué sueles ponerte el fin de semana y qué te pones para días especiales?
es.c: Describe tu conjunto favorito con una palabra de estilo, un estampado y un tejido.

fr.g: Parler de vêtements, de styles et de ce qui va bien aux gens.
p: Styles : casual (jean, t-shirt), smart (costume, chemise), sporty, comfortable.
Motifs et tissus : striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Compliments : That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
fr.q: Que portes-tu d'habitude le week-end, et que mets-tu pour les grandes occasions ?
fr.c: Décris ta tenue préférée avec un mot de style, un motif et un tissu.

it.g: Parla di vestiti, stili e di cosa sta bene alle persone.
p: Stili: casual (jeans, maglietta), smart (abito, camicia), sporty, comfortable.
Fantasie e tessuti: striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Complimenti: That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
it.q: Cosa indossi di solito nel fine settimana e cosa metti nelle occasioni speciali?
it.c: Descrivi il tuo outfit preferito con una parola di stile, una fantasia e un tessuto.

pt.g: Fala de roupa, estilos e do que fica bem às pessoas.
p: Estilos: casual (calças de ganga, t-shirt), smart (fato, camisa), sporty, comfortable.
Padrões e tecidos: striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Elogios: That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
pt.q: O que costumas vestir ao fim de semana e o que vestes em dias especiais?
pt.c: Descreve a tua roupa preferida com uma palavra de estilo, um padrão e um tecido.

pt_BR.g: Fale de roupas, estilos e do que fica bem nas pessoas.
p: Estilos: casual (jeans, camiseta), smart (terno, camisa social), sporty, comfortable.
Estampas e tecidos: striped, checked, plain, spotted, cotton, wool, leather.
Elogios: That jacket suits you. Those colours go well together.
pt_BR.q: O que você costuma usar no fim de semana e o que usa em dias especiais?
pt_BR.c: Descreva seu look favorito com uma palavra de estilo, uma estampa e um tecido.

vocab.ex: I prefer casual clothes, like jeans and trainers.
You need smart clothes for the interview.
He's wearing a blue and white striped shirt.
These shoes are really comfortable for walking.
I love that colour on you. It really suits you!
Do these trousers go with this jacket?

target.gram: Suit means it looks good on a person (It suits you). Go with means two items match (The bag goes with the shoes).

en.g: Ask for sizes, try things on and return items politely.
p: Sizes: Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Fitting: Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Returns: I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
en.q: Have you ever returned something you bought? What was the problem?
en.c: Role-play with me: ask for another size, try it on, then politely ask to exchange it.

de.g: Du fragst nach Größen, probierst an und tauschst höflich um.
p: Größen: Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Anprobe: Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Umtausch: I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
de.q: Hast du schon einmal etwas zurückgebracht? Was war das Problem?
de.c: Rollenspiel mit mir: Frag nach einer anderen Größe, probier an und tausch höflich um.

es.g: Pide tallas, pruébate ropa y devuelve cosas con educación.
p: Tallas: Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Probador: Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Devoluciones: I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
es.q: ¿Alguna vez has devuelto algo que compraste? ¿Cuál era el problema?
es.c: Haz un role-play conmigo: pide otra talla, pruébatela y pide un cambio con educación.

fr.g: Demander une taille, essayer et rapporter un article poliment.
p: Tailles : Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Essayage : Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Retours : I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
fr.q: As-tu déjà rapporté un achat au magasin ? Quel était le problème ?
fr.c: Jeu de rôle avec moi : demande une autre taille, essaie-la, puis demande un échange poliment.

it.g: Chiedi le taglie, prova i capi e fai un reso con gentilezza.
p: Taglie: Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Camerino: Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Resi: I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
it.q: Ti è mai capitato di restituire qualcosa che avevi comprato? Qual era il problema?
it.c: Gioco di ruolo con me: chiedi un'altra taglia, provala e chiedi gentilmente un cambio.

pt.g: Pede tamanhos, experimenta roupa e devolve artigos com educação.
p: Tamanhos: Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Provador: Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Devoluções: I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
pt.q: Já devolveste alguma coisa que compraste? Qual era o problema?
pt.c: Faz um role-play comigo: pede outro tamanho, experimenta e pede uma troca com educação.

pt_BR.g: Peça tamanhos, experimente roupas e devolva produtos com educação.
p: Tamanhos: Do you have this in a medium? Have you got a bigger size?
Provador: Can I try it on? It's too small. It fits perfectly. Where are the changing rooms?
Trocas: I'd like to return this. Can I get a refund or exchange it? Here's my receipt.
pt_BR.q: Você já devolveu algo que comprou? Qual era o problema?
pt_BR.c: Faça um role-play comigo: peça outro tamanho, experimente e peça uma troca com educação.

vocab.ex: Do you have this jumper in a medium?
Can I try on these jeans, please?
The shoes don't fit. They're too tight.
The changing rooms are next to the stairs.
I'd like a refund, please. Here's my receipt.
Can I exchange this shirt for a larger size?

target.gram: Fit is about size (It fits me), suit is about style. Try on is separable: try it on, not try on it.

en.g: Compare things fairly with as... as and not as... as.
p: Same level: This phone is as fast as that one. Use the basic adjective, not -er.
Less: The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. It means the red one is cheaper.
Make it softer or stronger: almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
en.q: Think of two things you own. Which is better, or are they just as good as each other?
en.c: Compare two products you'd like to buy in three sentences using as... as and not as... as.

de.g: Du vergleichst Dinge fair mit as... as und not as... as.
p: Gleich: This phone is as fast as that one. Mit Grundform des Adjektivs, nicht -er.
Weniger: The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. Also ist die rote billiger.
Abstufen: almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
de.q: Denk an zwei Dinge, die du besitzt. Welches ist besser, oder sind beide gleich gut?
de.c: Vergleich zwei Produkte, die du kaufen möchtest, in drei Sätzen mit as... as und not as... as.

es.g: Compara cosas de forma justa con as... as y not as... as.
p: Igualdad: This phone is as fast as that one. Con el adjetivo básico, sin -er.
Menos: The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. O sea, el rojo es más barato.
Matices: almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
es.q: Piensa en dos cosas que tienes. ¿Cuál es mejor, o son igual de buenas?
es.c: Compara dos productos que quieres comprar en tres frases con as... as y not as... as.

fr.g: Comparer des choses de façon juste avec as... as et not as... as.
p: Égalité : This phone is as fast as that one. Adjectif de base, sans -er.
Moins : The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. Donc le rouge coûte moins cher.
Nuancer : almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
fr.q: Pense à deux objets que tu possèdes. Lequel est le meilleur, ou sont-ils aussi bien l'un que l'autre ?
fr.c: Compare deux produits que tu aimerais acheter en trois phrases avec as... as et not as... as.

it.g: Confronta le cose in modo equo con as... as e not as... as.
p: Uguaglianza: This phone is as fast as that one. Aggettivo base, senza -er.
Meno: The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. Cioè la rossa costa meno.
Sfumature: almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
it.q: Pensa a due cose che possiedi. Quale è migliore, o sono buone allo stesso modo?
it.c: Confronta due prodotti che vorresti comprare in tre frasi con as... as e not as... as.

pt.g: Compara coisas de forma justa com as... as e not as... as.
p: Igualdade: This phone is as fast as that one. Com o adjetivo base, sem -er.
Menos: The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. Ou seja, a vermelha é mais barata.
Matizes: almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
pt.q: Pensa em duas coisas que tens. Qual é melhor, ou são igualmente boas?
pt.c: Compara dois produtos que gostavas de comprar em três frases com as... as e not as... as.

pt_BR.g: Compare coisas de forma justa com as... as e not as... as.
p: Igualdade: This phone is as fast as that one. Com o adjetivo base, sem -er.
Menos: The red bag isn't as expensive as the black one. Ou seja, a vermelha é mais barata.
Nuances: almost as good as, just as cheap as, not nearly as big as.
pt_BR.q: Pense em duas coisas que você tem. Qual é melhor, ou são igualmente boas?
pt_BR.c: Compare dois produtos que você quer comprar em três frases com as... as e not as... as.

vocab.ex: My new laptop is as fast as my brother's.
This brand isn't as expensive as the famous one.
The cheaper headphones are just as good as these.
Their flat is almost as big as a house.
The old model is not nearly as light as the new one.
My phone is the same as yours, but in blue.

target.gram: as + adjective + as = equal (as cheap as). not as + adjective + as = less (not as heavy as). Never as cheaper as.

en.g: Learn the verbs you need to talk about cooking.
p: Cutting: chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Heat: boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Mixing and adding: mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
en.q: What do you usually cook, and which cooking verbs do you use most?
en.c: Describe how you make your breakfast using at least four cooking verbs.

de.g: Du lernst die Verben, um übers Kochen zu sprechen.
p: Schneiden: chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Hitze: boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Mischen und hinzufügen: mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
de.q: Was kochst du normalerweise, und welche Kochverben brauchst du am meisten?
de.c: Beschreib, wie du dein Frühstück machst, mit mindestens vier Kochverben.

es.g: Aprende los verbos que necesitas para hablar de cocinar.
p: Cortar: chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Calor: boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Mezclar y añadir: mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
es.q: ¿Qué sueles cocinar y qué verbos de cocina usas más?
es.c: Describe cómo preparas tu desayuno usando al menos cuatro verbos de cocina.

fr.g: Apprendre les verbes utiles pour parler de cuisine.
p: Couper : chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Cuire : boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Mélanger et ajouter : mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
fr.q: Que cuisines-tu d'habitude, et quels verbes de cuisine utilises-tu le plus ?
fr.c: Décris comment tu prépares ton petit-déjeuner avec au moins quatre verbes de cuisine.

it.g: Impara i verbi che servono per parlare di cucina.
p: Tagliare: chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Cuocere: boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Mescolare e aggiungere: mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
it.q: Cosa cucini di solito e quali verbi di cucina usi di più?
it.c: Descrivi come prepari la tua colazione usando almeno quattro verbi di cucina.

pt.g: Aprende os verbos de que precisas para falar de cozinhar.
p: Cortar: chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Calor: boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Misturar e juntar: mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
pt.q: O que costumas cozinhar e que verbos de cozinha usas mais?
pt.c: Descreve como preparas o teu pequeno-almoço com pelo menos quatro verbos de cozinha.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda os verbos que você precisa para falar de cozinhar.
p: Cortar: chop onions, slice bread, peel potatoes, grate cheese.
Calor: boil water, fry an egg, bake a cake, roast vegetables, grill fish.
Misturar e acrescentar: mix, stir, add salt, pour milk, heat the oil.
pt_BR.q: O que você costuma cozinhar e quais verbos de cozinha usa mais?
pt_BR.c: Descreva como você prepara seu café da manhã usando pelo menos quatro verbos de cozinha.

vocab.ex: Chop the onions into small pieces.
Can you slice the bread, please?
Boil the pasta for ten minutes.
I usually fry eggs in a little olive oil.
My grandma bakes bread every Sunday.
Stir the soup so it doesn't burn.

target.gram: Cooking instructions use the imperative: Chop the onions. Boil the water. Don't add too much salt.

en.g: Explain the steps of a recipe in a clear order.
p: Sequence words: first, then, next, after that, finally.
Recipes use short imperatives: First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Time and quantity: for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
en.q: What's a simple dish you could teach me to make, step by step?
en.c: Write a five-step recipe for your favourite snack using first, then, next, after that, finally.

de.g: Du erklärst die Schritte eines Rezepts in klarer Reihenfolge.
p: Reihenfolge: first, then, next, after that, finally.
Rezepte nutzen kurze Imperative: First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Zeit und Menge: for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
de.q: Welches einfache Gericht könntest du mir Schritt für Schritt beibringen?
de.c: Schreib ein Rezept in fünf Schritten für deinen Lieblingssnack mit first, then, next, after that, finally.

es.g: Explica los pasos de una receta en un orden claro.
p: Conectores de orden: first, then, next, after that, finally.
Las recetas usan imperativos cortos: First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Tiempo y cantidad: for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
es.q: ¿Qué plato sencillo podrías enseñarme a preparar paso a paso?
es.c: Escribe una receta de cinco pasos de tu snack favorito con first, then, next, after that, finally.

fr.g: Expliquer les étapes d'une recette dans un ordre clair.
p: Mots d'ordre : first, then, next, after that, finally.
Les recettes utilisent des impératifs courts : First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Temps et quantité : for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
fr.q: Quel plat simple pourrais-tu m'apprendre à préparer, étape par étape ?
fr.c: Écris une recette en cinq étapes de ton en-cas préféré avec first, then, next, after that, finally.

it.g: Spiega i passaggi di una ricetta in un ordine chiaro.
p: Parole di sequenza: first, then, next, after that, finally.
Le ricette usano imperativi brevi: First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Tempi e dosi: for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
it.q: Quale piatto semplice potresti insegnarmi a preparare, passo dopo passo?
it.c: Scrivi una ricetta in cinque passi del tuo snack preferito con first, then, next, after that, finally.

pt.g: Explica os passos de uma receita por uma ordem clara.
p: Palavras de sequência: first, then, next, after that, finally.
As receitas usam imperativos curtos: First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Tempo e quantidade: for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
pt.q: Que prato simples me podias ensinar a fazer, passo a passo?
pt.c: Escreve uma receita de cinco passos do teu petisco preferido com first, then, next, after that, finally.

pt_BR.g: Explique os passos de uma receita em uma ordem clara.
p: Palavras de sequência: first, then, next, after that, finally.
Receitas usam imperativos curtos: First, heat the oil. Then add the garlic.
Tempo e quantidade: for five minutes, until golden, a pinch of salt, two spoons of sugar.
pt_BR.q: Que prato simples você poderia me ensinar a fazer, passo a passo?
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma receita de cinco passos do seu lanche favorito com first, then, next, after that, finally.

vocab.ex: First, wash the vegetables.
Then cut them into small pieces.
Next, put everything in a big pan.
After that, cook it for twenty minutes.
Finally, add some fresh herbs and serve.
Fry the onions until golden.

target.gram: Order steps with first, then, next, after that, finally + imperative. Use until to say when to stop: cook until soft.

en.g: Describe a typical dish from your country to someone new.
p: Ingredients: It's made with rice, beans and meat. It contains a lot of garlic.
Taste and texture: It tastes sweet, spicy, salty or sour. It's crispy, soft or creamy.
When and how: You usually eat it with bread, at lunch, on special occasions.
en.q: What's one dish from your country that every visitor should try, and why?
en.c: Describe a typical dish in four sentences: ingredients, taste, how you eat it and when.

de.g: Du beschreibst jemandem ein typisches Gericht aus deinem Land.

Wann und wie: You usually eat it with bread, at lunch, on special occasions.
de.q: Welches Gericht aus deinem Land sollte jeder Besucher probieren, und warum?
de.c: Beschreib ein typisches Gericht in vier Sätzen: Zutaten, Geschmack, wie und wann man es isst.

You usually eat it with fresh bread.

en.g: Find what you need and name food containers in a supermarket.
p: Places: aisle, shelf, checkout, trolley, basket, the frozen food section.
Containers: a loaf of bread, a carton of milk, a bag of rice, a tin of tomatoes, a jar of jam.
Questions: Excuse me, where can I find the rice? Is it in aisle five? Do you need a bag?
en.q: What's always on your shopping list, and how do you say each item with its container?
en.c: Write a shopping list of six items, each with a container word like a bottle of or a box of.

vocab.ex: The pasta is in aisle three.

en.g: Talk about real possibilities in the future and their results.
p: Form: If + present simple, will + verb. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
No will after if: If I see her, I'll tell her. Not: If I will see her.
You can swap the halves: We'll stay at home if it rains. No comma in this order.
en.q: What will you do this weekend if the weather is nice? And if it isn't?
en.c: Write four first conditional sentences about your plans: two if it's sunny, two if it rains.

de.g: Du sprichst über reale Möglichkeiten in der Zukunft und ihre Folgen.
p: Form: If + present simple, will + Verb. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
Kein will nach if: If I see her, I'll tell her. Nicht: If I will see her.
Die Teile lassen sich tauschen: We'll stay at home if it rains. Dann ohne Komma.
de.q: Was machst du am Wochenende, wenn das Wetter schön ist? Und wenn nicht?
de.c: Schreib vier Sätze im first conditional zu deinen Plänen: zwei bei Sonne, zwei bei Regen.

es.g: Habla de posibilidades reales en el futuro y sus resultados.
p: Forma: If + present simple, will + verbo. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
Nada de will después de if: If I see her, I'll tell her. No: If I will see her.
Puedes invertir las partes: We'll stay at home if it rains. En ese orden, sin coma.
es.q: ¿Qué harás este fin de semana si hace buen tiempo? ¿Y si no?
es.c: Escribe cuatro frases en first conditional sobre tus planes: dos si hace sol y dos si llueve.

fr.g: Parler de possibilités réelles dans le futur et de leurs conséquences.
p: Forme : If + present simple, will + verbe. If it rains, we'll stay at home.
Pas de will après if : If I see her, I'll tell her. Pas : If I will see her.
On peut inverser : We'll stay at home if it rains. Dans cet ordre, pas de virgule.
fr.q: Que feras-tu ce week-end s'il fait beau ? Et s'il ne fait pas beau ?
fr.c: Écris quatre phrases au first conditional sur tes projets : deux s'il fait beau, deux s'il pleut.

it.g: Parla di possibilità reali nel futuro e delle loro conseguenze.
p: Forma: If + present simple, will + verbo. If it rains, we'll stay at home.

Puoi invertire le parti: We'll stay at home if it rains. In quest'ordine, niente virgola.
it.q: Cosa farai questo fine settimana se il tempo è bello? E se non lo è?
it.c: Scrivi quattro frasi al first conditional sui tuoi piani: due se c'è il sole, due se piove.

pt.q: O que vais fazer este fim de semana se estiver bom tempo? E se não estiver?
pt.c: Escreve quatro frases no first conditional sobre os teus planos: duas se estiver sol, duas se chover.

pt_BR.g: Fale de possibilidades reais no futuro e dos resultados delas.
p: Forma: If + present simple, will + verbo. If it rains, we'll stay at home.

vocab.ex: If it rains, we'll watch a film at home.

target.gram: First conditional: If + present simple, will/won't + base verb. Never use will in the if-clause.
